\chapter{Boolean Analysis — SurfaceArea}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.SurfaceArea
\section{Overview}
The rotation definition gives an extended Gaussian perimeter, with a genuine right limit, null-set invariance, halfspace values, and isoperimetric bounds.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[Secant slopes bounded by infinitesimal slopes]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.subadditive_quotient_le_liminf}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $f\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be continuous at zero with $f(0)=0$ and $f(s+t)\le f(s)+f(t)$ for all real $s,t$. Then for every $\delta>0$, $[f(\delta)/\delta]_+\le\liminf_{t\to0^+}[f(t)/t]_+$ in $[0,\infty]$, where $[u]_+=\max(u,0)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Positive-angle quotient bounded by perimeter]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.rotationSensitivity_quotient_le_surfaceArea}

\difficulty{4}
Let $n\ge0$, let $\gamma_n$ be standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$, and let $G,G\prime$ be independent vectors with law $\gamma_n$. Write $s_A(t)$ for the real value of the product-measure mass $(\gamma_n\otimes\gamma_n)\{(g,h):\mathbf1_A(g)\ne\mathbf1_A(\cos t\,g+\sin t\,h)\}$. Write $P_\gamma(A)=\liminf_{t\to0^+}\bigl[\sqrt{\pi/2}\,s_A(t)/t\bigr]_+$ in $[0,\infty]$, where $[x]_+=\max(x,0)$. If $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$ is measurable and $\delta>0$, then $[\sqrt{\pi/2}\,s_A(\delta)/\delta]_+\le P_\gamma(A)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Gaussian perimeter of a halfspace]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.surfaceArea_halfspace}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.gaussianSurfaceArea, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.halfspace_rotation_quotient_tendsto, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.standardGaussianPDF}
\difficulty{1}
Let $n\ge0$, let $\gamma_n$ be standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$, and let $G,G\prime$ be independent vectors with law $\gamma_n$. Write $s_A(t)$ for the real value of the product-measure mass $(\gamma_n\otimes\gamma_n)\{(g,h):\mathbf1_A(g)\ne\mathbf1_A(\cos t\,g+\sin t\,h)\}$. Write $P_\gamma(A)=\liminf_{t\to0^+}\bigl[\sqrt{\pi/2}\,s_A(t)/t\bigr]_+$ in $[0,\infty]$, where $[x]_+=\max(x,0)$. For a vector $v\in\mathbb R^n$ with $\sum_i v_i^2=1$ and real $t$, the halfspace $H=\{z:\sum_i v_i z_i\le t\}$ satisfies $P_\gamma(H)=\varphi(t)$, where $\varphi(t)=(2\pi)^{-1/2}e^{-t^2/2}$.
\end{theorem}
